retrievalProfile.description: A cinematic, low-light interior scene featuring a candid interaction at a bar with an integrated vertical marketing strip and elegant script title.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dimly lit, atmospheric bar scene captured in a candid style, featuring a man and woman in the foreground and blurred patrons in the background. The composition is framed by a prominent vertical 'obi strip' on the left and a flowing, handwritten-style title across the top.
coreVisualRelationships: The vertical obi strip acts as a structural anchor against the horizontal bar counter.
Warm, localized lighting on the subjects contrasts with the dark, moody background.
The diagonal line of the bar counter creates depth and leads the eye toward the background patrons.
The fluid script title balances the rigid verticality of the left-hand graphic elements.
coreInvariants: Warm color temperature with amber and mahogany tones.
Shallow depth of field focusing on the foreground subjects.
Presence of a vertical decorative strip on the left edge.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two primary subjects in the lower foreground, occupying approximately 60% of the frame width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vertical obi strip on the left edge provides a high-contrast graphic anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the top-left script, moves down the obi strip, then follows the bar counter into the depth of the image.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, underexposed areas in the upper-right and background provide breathing room for the title.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep mahogany and shadow blacks (background and furniture).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Creamy whites and marble grays (bar top and obi strip background).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm amber and gold (lighting and glassware).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low-key lighting with high value contrast on the bar surface and graphic elements.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Fluid, slanted cursive with varying stroke weights
letterConstructionRules: Connected lowercase letters with long, sweeping ascenders and descenders
Capital letters feature decorative loops and flourishes
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'F' and 'B' have exaggerated, expressive top loops
Terminal 'g' and 's' have long, tapering tails
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair the expressive script with a rigid, vertical sans-serif or gothic typeface on the side strip for functional contrast.
graphicDevices: Vertical obi strip with diagonal stripe patterns
Circular logo emblems within the strip

preserve: The vertical orientation of the side strip

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the hand-drawn, fluid motion of the main title
Matches the utilitarian feel of the vertical strip text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cinematic photograph of a 1980s bar interior with a marble counter, warm lighting, and two people in candid conversation, leaving the top 20% and left 15% clear for overlays.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a vertical white strip on the left with red/blue diagonal accents and vertical text. Place a large, elegant off-white script title across the top center.

verificationChecks: Is the script title legible against the dark background?
Does the obi strip feel integrated rather than pasted on?
Is the lighting on the bar surface consistent with the subjects?
Does the grain and color feel like 35mm film?

adjustableVariables: Width of the vertical obi strip
mustRedesign: Avoid using specific brand logos from the original
Ensure the script is an original drawing, not a direct font copy
Change the specific faces of the subjects to avoid likeness issues
postGenerationChecks: Verify the vertical strip contains vertical text orientation.
Check that the script title has a consistent slant.
Ensure the marble texture on the bar is visible.
Confirm the color palette is dominated by warm browns and creams.
recipe.reuseFormula: Dimly lit bar photography + Vertical Obi Strip + Fluid Script Title = 80s Noir Album Aesthetic
